# Devonshire Custom Homes (concept site by Kerblabs)

> Luxury custom home builder in Tampa, FL, serving Tampa and St. Pete. This is a free concept page, not the builder's own site (devonshirecustomhomes.com).

## Facts (from their site)
- Address: 3412 West Bay to Bay Blvd, Tampa, FL 33629
- Phone: (813) 548-4403
- Founded: 2009 by Brooke and Josh Layton
- Service: full-service custom home design and construction, from initial concept through final build
- Scale: 170+ projects completed, projects in more than 20 neighborhoods (per their site)
- Contact form areas: Bayshore Beautiful, Beach Park, Parkland Estates, Snell Isle, Davis Islands, Hyde Park, Venetian Isles
- Partnership: exclusive regional partner of the Southern Living Custom Builder Program (per their site)
- Contact: https://devonshirecustomhomes.com/contact

## FAQ
- What does Devonshire Custom Homes do? Full-service custom home design and construction in Tampa and St. Pete.
- Where do they build? Tampa and St. Pete, in more than 20 neighborhoods.
- How do I start a conversation? Call (813) 548-4403 or use the contact form: https://devonshirecustomhomes.com/contact
